note: round 42 (RE42-MODES). Static entries are RVAs of WardogsClient-Win64-Shipping.restored.exe; data entries are read from cooked packages.

alert_state_update.rule: level = max(highest detection level among this AI's own perceived targets, highest level among the AIs returned by 0x8870590 for the target); walk the threshold list in file order (Relaxed, Alert, Combat); a candidate passes if level >= LowerThreshold and, when its sight flag applies, the sight strength stored for the current target is above 0.0001; the walk stops at the first failure; the state is the last passing entry (Relaxed when none pass).
alert_state_update.sight_flag_choice: bRequireSightToTransitionFromHigher is used when the current state is at or above the candidate, bRequireSightToTransitionFromLower otherwise
alert_state_update.thresholds_asset: AlertStateThreashold_DataConfig: Relaxed 0.0, Alert 0.8, Combat 1.0 (sight required only to rise into Combat)

is_firing_test.reader: 0x6B96BF0 (returns the byte); IsCurrentlyFiring BP getter 0x6B99300; variant 0x6B96C00 / 0x6B99320 also needs the byte at +0xFEC above 0
is_firing_test.writers: slot 175 (0x6B980A0) sets the word at +0xFE1 to 0x0101; slot 176 (0x6B98560) and the tail of 0x6B980A0 clear it
is_firing_test.target_weapon_lookup: AI reads it from the target character's weapon component via the character's component getter (vtable +1848)

significance_rules.sphere_0x50D30B0: per object, squared distance d2 to the nearest viewer; level = highest index i whose squared threshold is at or below d2 (0 when none; also 0 when d2 <= LowestNonZeroSignificanceDistance squared); the object keeps the lower of its stored level and the new one
significance_rules.fov_0x50D2CE0: per object and viewer: unit direction to the object; dot with the viewer facing; d2 as above; level 0 when dot >= HighestConeCosAngle and d2 <= FurthestDistanceSquared; otherwise the first setting index 1.. whose cone cosine <= dot and squared distance >= d2 (only if dot > LowestConeCosAngle and d2 <= FurthestDistanceSquared); keeps the lower of stored and new
significance_rules.combination: every evaluator only lowers the stored level, so the result is the minimum over evaluators and viewers; level 0 is the nearest or most central band
significance_rules.setup: 0x50D2FC0 (FOV) and 0x50D32E0 (Sphere) square the distances and cache the min and max cone cosine

streaming.device_profile_note: r.Streaming.PoolSize 1280 and r.Nanite.Streaming.StreamingPoolSize 256 or 512 only in console device profiles
